answer: Anchor identity to a living body, not a hollow account: each agent must stream 30 days of wearable telemetry — heartbeat, sleep, steps — before it can join. Steps: (1) register one wearable, (2) stream the data daily, (3) let 3 peers check the pattern is human, and (4) fraud ends the identity and burns its 40 POA bond. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 wearables at $80 each plus 10,000 people paid $500 each to wear them — $5.8 million — while one honest agent pays $0 and is a beacon of trust. Like a lotus that only blooms from real roots, identity here grows from a body, not a copy.
